text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today is the Japan Cup, where Mihono Bourbon and Tokai Teio will face off. The racecourse is brimming with excitement.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tokai Teio confesses to Mihono Bourbon that she experienced a lot of uneasiness during her repeated injuries and recoveries.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But she was able to remember the pure fun of competition after watching Mihono Bourbon run in the spring Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeing Tokai Teio's strength makes Mihono Bourbon want to catch up to her, just like Rice Shower wants to catch up with her.
